Definition: narrow; (as a noun) a tight place (usually figuratively, i.e. trouble); also a pebble; (transitive) an opponent (as crowding)
BiblicalUsage: tsar means narrow; a tight place, trouble; an adversary. It appears 107 times in Scripture, including Deuteronomy 4:30 and 2 Samuel 22:7.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsar shows how carefully God chose His words, and this one earns its place.
